name: Who's this?
description: Someone you don't know wrote to you: context.dev looks up the company behind their email address (a personal address is skipped, at no cost), NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL says who they are and whether it's worth a reply, and you choose whether to remember them. Needs CONTEXT_DEV_API_KEY and NEBIUS_API_KEY.
example:
From: Nithin <nithin@zerodha.com>
Subject: Partnering on your trading app

Hi, we'd love to talk about listing your app on our developer platform. Free for a call this week?

assistants.name: Company lookup (context.dev)
assistants.description: Finds the company behind a website or a work email.

assistants.name: Sizer-up (Nemotron Super VL)
assistants.description: Weighs up who someone is and what they want.
